summary: Turn healthcare evidence and service data into defensible decisions. Practise PICO, GRADE, and improvement measures. Explore the course.
lede: Healthcare analytics for evidence-based decisions uses routine care data and published research to inform clinical quality and service choices. For clinical quality leads, healthcare analysts, and service managers, the course covers framing PICO questions, appraising evidence with GRADE, and selecting measures through the Donabedian model. Participants also practise checking cohort comparisons and using Excel summaries to turn findings into proportionate actions and an evidence-to-action brief.
audienceIntro: This course suits intermediate professionals who use healthcare evidence or service data to guide clinical quality, care delivery, and resource decisions.
prerequisites: Prior experience working with healthcare service data, clinical quality information, or healthcare research is recommended. You should be comfortable interpreting basic tables and percentages. Coding or programming is not required; exercises use Excel and structured teaching datasets.
